question_text: A police officer enters a private residence without a warrant and confiscates illegal drugs found in plain view. The homeowner is charged with illegal possession of drugs. Which of the following is the best constitutional argument for the defense?

options.text: The search was unreasonable because it was done without a warrant.
The drugs were not in plain view because they were hidden.
The police officer had no probable cause to enter the residence.
The homeowner has a right to privacy that was violated.
